title: A note on the scatteredness of reflection orders
summary: In this note, we characterize affine and non-affine Coxeter systems among all Coxeter systems in terms of the structure of their reflection orders. For an infinite irreducible system $(W,S)$, we show that affineness can be characterized in three equivalent ways: by the scatteredness of all reflection orders, by the existence of a reflection order of type $ω+ ω^*$, and by a finiteness property of intervals determined by dihedral reflection subgroups.
